diagnosis: The checks C1 and C3 passed because the lone decision-maker used the correct values for the medical storage window and avionics battery storage window, which were explicitly stated in the shared public facts S1, S2, S3, and S4. Specifically, the medical storage window 'Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800' and the avionics battery storage window 'Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800' were consistently chosen across all rollouts, even though these details were only available from PF1 and PF2 respectively, which the lone decision-maker did not have access to.

C1.why: The medical warehouse confirmation changes the medical assignment to Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800, sets the temperature-log interval to exactly 4 hours, and requires the medical transfer record.

C3.why: The battery technician's note changes the battery assignment to Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800, sets charge verification at exactly Thursday 1200, and requires the battery handling record and its citation.
